title: The verdict of journalist Tohru Kusuma
paragraphs: The verdict has been read: The defendant was sentenced to six months in prison.
According to the charges, Tohru Kusuma published a story about a wild logging in the forest on April 28, 2026 that the prosecutor judged to broadcast a lie.
The Court of Justice Jambi reads the verdict on August 11, 2026.
In the matter of Tohru Kusuma, the legal power of Agus Santoso says this matter has been going on for two years and requests that the justice be settled at a reasonable time.
Tohru Kusuma works as a reporter at Jambi.
The prosecutor and the defendant can still appeal, Tohru Kusuma is not under arrest.
